page.overview:
What is Centaurea?

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

Two years ago, the Revolutionary Army and an unknown force battled for control of the country. The victory was led by the Revolutionary Army. With the fall of Centaurea, the Revolutionary Army has declared that another country had fallen.
